integrity: The proof reduces both symmetrizations to a pair of regular 2n-gons related by polarity, computes their exact radii and relative half-sector rotation, and proves translational optimality by an equality of supporting-strip widths. A standalone polygonal checker independently reconstructs the operations for n from 3 through 51; finite replay is not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The new content concerns the forward harmonic-to-arithmetic containment factor for centered regular odd polygons with at least five sides. The triangle endpoint is previously published, and the reverse regular-polygon factor is previously published. The theorem does not classify all equality cases of the planar lower envelope.
title: Exact harmonic–arithmetic contraction for regular polygons
